command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$base='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_09/nodes'; `$nodes=@('Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); `$cmds=@('display vrrp','display vrrp interface Vlanif20','display vrrp interface Vlanif20 verbose','display current-configuration interface Vlanif20','display ospf peer brief','display ip routing-table 10.3.10.1'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){foreach(`$c in `$cmds){`$u=`$base+'/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u; Write-Output ('### '+`$n+' | '+`$c); Write-Output `$r.output}}"
